## Case A — actual dispatch, exact sequence, acknowledged application

Retain actual prepared serialized W4/W8 graph and original Concurrent forced-separate reference. Use nontrivial asymmetric gains/mutes/crossfeed and legal trailing population. Capture post-matrix PCM words; compare `to_bits`, not Vec<f32> equality. Identify which member population is actually offered/accepted and assert true fused delta on eligible graph calls, not merely process-entry counts. Preserve the existing graph-pairing-to-separate actual production mutation and SAME positive assertion; restore it before the accepted rerun. No additional mutation campaign is required.

Extend the existing private PairFixture sequence, not a new event corpus. Its paired and separate owners keep identical real queues and initial state. For each named call assert exact fused/fallback delta, both PCM word arrays, current/target/step/countdown/remembered-gain/mute snapshots and two logical stage counters:

- Settled initial call and immediate same-queue FIFO fader changes plus a matrix command.
- Admit positive fader/matrix ramps through queues, then invoke composite process WITHOUT manual pre-drain. For a concrete boundary discriminator, choose ramp length3 with call frames2, then frames2: first call leaves1, second must remain fallback despite ending after its first sample; the following call must fuse. A separate existing direct false-bridge probe may still manually drain to prove false causes no state/PCM mutation.
- Mid-ramp retarget and muted gain memory/unmute, preserving the existing exact setter rules; reset followed by settled dispatch.
- Existing raw-record error-order tests retained; compare completed fader PCM/counter outcome to the old owner sequence for matrix error, not only “output changed.”

Inside the existing WebEngine two-record acknowledgement test, under its nondefault test-support feature, snapshot/reset immediately around the real render_next call after submit_commands. Assert admitted2, exact applied_at_sample and existing output relation AND the paired process/true-fused delta for that same call. Producer/host API stays private/exclusive as before. Do not replace actual host linkage with a prose similarity argument. Retain ordinary rejection/backpressure tests.

## Case C — actual queued graph allocation/free scope

Reuse the same prepared compiler graph in allocation_tracker with allocating Capture observers disabled. Prepare actual consumers/producers, buffers, observation streams and witnesses off render. Arm only PreparedRenderPlan::render. Drive three finite phases using off-render queue submissions and meter drains: eligible settled, positive ramp/retarget to settled, and the real observed cohort with another eligible tail. Repeated calls must show the intended true/fallback/decline mechanisms and exactly zero allocations AND frees. No queue setup, observer Vec growth, assertions, snapshot collection or teardown inside the armed call.

Retain positive allocation and free liveness in its own off-render probe. The existing realloc override must increment the tested allocation activity counter (conservative nonzero allocation activity is enough) as well as the old layout tracker; verify a controlled live realloc probe off render so a direct realloc cannot evade the zero gate. Keep thread-local arming/RAII restoration and existing SESSION serialization; no new global allocator or shared process mode.

The accepted direct TestOnlyFaderMatrixPair arithmetic audit may remain as an extra small test, but cannot substitute for the queued graph/observed fallback phases.
